cohort: The study included 39 patients (33 women and 6 men) with a mean age of 40.6 years (range, 17-77 years) who underwent laparoscopic MAL release at a single institution from March 2007 to July 2014.
finding: Laparoscopic MAL release is a safe and effective treatment for MALS, with 84.6% of patients reporting symptom relief after surgery, and atherosclerotic risk factors may predict poorer outcomes.
